entities.summary: Mitch Green is an American former professional boxer who competed from 1980 to 2005. He is best known for being the second man to have gone the distance with Mike Tyson in 1986, who was undefeated at the time. Two years later, in 1988, Green ended up fighting Tyson again in a notorious street brawl. A toothpick dangling between his lips became his trademark at any public appearance.
